select *,(select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id) as production_status,case when status='early_terminated' and summary_status='not_started' and (select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id)='early_terminated' then 'terminated' when status='in_progress' and summary_status='not_started' and (select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id)='in_progress' then 'filling' when status='completed' and (select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id)='completed' and summary_status='not_started' then 'pending_summary' when status='completed' and (select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id)='completed' and summary_status='draft' then 'summarizing' when status='completed' and (select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id)='completed' and summary_status='pending_review' then 'pending_review' when status='completed' and (select p.status from production_object p where p.id=dhr_instance.production_object_id and p.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id)='completed' and summary_status='formalized' then 'finalized' else 'status_error' end as display_status,(select t.reason from dhr_termination t where t.dhr_instance_id=dhr_instance.id and t.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id) as termination_reason,(select t.terminated_at from dhr_termination t where t.dhr_instance_id=dhr_instance.id and t.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id) as termination_at,(select t.terminated_by from dhr_termination t where t.dhr_instance_id=dhr_instance.id and t.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id) as terminated_by,(select t.snapshot_json is not null from dhr_termination t where t.dhr_instance_id=dhr_instance.id and t.tenant_id=dhr_instance.tenant_id) as termination_snapshot_available from dhr_instance where tenant_id=? and id=?
